title: Settings
subtitle: View the effective server configuration. Edit config/config.yaml and reload it here.
defaultProjectDescription: Pin the project selected when the app starts
storageNote: Language, start page and default project stay in this browser; runtime settings come from the server YAML.

effective.title: Effective runtime configuration
effective.description: These values are active in the current process. Runtime settings are managed by config/config.yaml; secrets are read only from environment variables. Reload after editing the file.
effective.loadFailed: Could not load effective configuration. Check service status and administrator access.
effective.reloadFailed: Configuration reload failed; the active configuration was preserved.
effective.restartRequired: These fields require a service restart
effective.legacyDatabase: Legacy AI/Jev settings were found in the database; they no longer override YAML configuration.
effective.secretNote: Secret values are never returned. Reference environment variables in config.yaml, for example ${QA_AI_API_KEY}.
effective.approvalBoundary: AUTO may analyze failures and prepare proposals. It never writes source code; a person must apply each patch and separately start verification.

aiConfig.title: General AI provider
aiConfig.description: Used by the QA Assistant, requirement analysis, test generation and failure diagnosis. Connection testing uses the current effective AppConfig.
aiConfig.loadFailed: Could not load AI settings. Check the service status.
aiConfig.keyConfigured: Configured; leave blank to keep the current key
aiConfig.secretNote: The key is never returned to the browser. Only security administrators can save settings or test connections.
aiConfig.saveFailed: Could not save AI settings. Check the values and security administrator access.
aiConfig.connectionFailed: Connection test failed. Check the configuration, permissions and network.
aiConfig.fallbackActive: A fallback provider is active; no real model is serving this status.
aiConfig.realProviderStatus: The configured real provider passed its health check.
aiConfig.providerProbeFailed: The real provider probe failed; fallback use has not been confirmed.

jev.title: Jev decision provider
jev.description: Shows the Jev settings currently used by the platform Decision Layer. Connection testing uses the effective configuration.
jev.loadFailed: Could not load Jev settings. Check administrator access and service status.
jev.keyConfigured: Configured; leave blank to keep the current key
jev.secretNote: The key is never returned to the browser or saved in browser storage.
jev.saveFailed: Could not save Jev settings. Check the values and administrator access.
jev.notChecked: Connection has not been tested. A successful probe only confirms API reachability, not runtime enablement.
jev.runtimeNotChecked: The current runtime configuration has not been checked.
jev.runtimeCheckFailed: Jev runtime check failed. Check the service and administrator permissions.
jev.connectionFailed: The connection test request failed. Check service status.
jev.playgroundDescription: Submit dynamic state and options to validate the provider-neutral decision API and confidence fallback policy.
jev.optionsHelp: Provide at least two options; add unknown as a safe fallback option if useful.
jev.playgroundFailed: Decision request failed. Check Jev settings and administrator access.

budget.description: The preflight budget uses estimated input tokens plus any explicitly configured output limit; it is not the model's capability limit. The model or gateway still enforces its own limits. Usage contains only provider-reported tokens.

health.title: Runtime health and AI usage
health.loadFailed: Some checks failed. Retry and inspect service logs.

states.LOCAL_EXECUTION_AVAILABLE: Local task execution is available (no remote Worker connected)
states.PROBE_TIMEOUT: Probe timed out; state is unconfirmed

usage.title: AI usage today
usage.allFeatures: Leave empty for all features; enter exact name to filter
usage.tokenNote: Provider-reported: input {{input}} / output {{output}} tokens; {{unknown}} calls did not report usage.
